close_reason: Removed redundant id re-injection after create_object in identity.rs; create_object contract guarantees id is set
description: identity.rs:216-227: the handler serializes the full created_obj (which already has the correct server-assigned id from the backend), then unconditionally mutates the JSON to insert the id again. The second insertion is redundant — the id is already present and correct. This looks like a bug workaround that was never removed. If it IS needed (e.g. if the backend could return an object with a placeholder id), that constraint should be documented. Otherwise delete the injection block and add a test that verifies the id is correct in the response.
title: Identity/set create: redundant id injection after full-object serialization
